about_the_game:
What began as a child’s game has become humanity’s last hope.

You are a raccoon trained for a mission no human could complete. Enter the abandoned Krämers Mansion, now crawling with the undead, the people who once called it home.

Guided by instinct and memory, you will face rooms filled with traps and puzzles inspired by the original dark versions of familiar fairy tales.

Embrace your raccoon nature. Steal shiny objects to uncover the mansion’s past, sneak through dark corridors, find food, take naps, climb, and roll whenever you want. Curiosity may keep you alive or lead you to your doom.

Every door you open brings you closer to the salvation of mankind. But when the time comes, will you choose to save them?

Features:

  • Explore an interconnected mansion filled with hidden rooms, haunting stories, and secrets.

  • Solve environmental puzzles inspired by dark European folklore and classic fables.

  • Piece together the story through collectible shiny objects and an annoying talking raven.

  • Survive deadly traps and face rats, bats, chickens, and zombies.

  • Experience atmospheric visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, combining realism and horror.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Survive as a raccoon in an abandoned mansion filled with zombies. Solve puzzles inspired by dark fairy tales and explore to uncover whether the world is worth saving.
